designationHistory.indexText: The Wassaw Island Trust, formed by the Parsons family, sold Wassaw Island to The Nature Conservancy in 1969, which conveyed it to the federal government as Wassaw National Wildlife Refuge.

authority.citation: Deed from The Nature Conservancy (FWS cites a Deed of Donation dated October 20, 1969)

designationHistory.note: Pass A (2011 CCP: designated a refuge on October 20, 1969, by a Deed of Donation from The Nature Conservancy "for the sum of one dollar") and Pass B (New Georgia Encyclopedia: in 1969 the trust sold the island to the Conservancy for $1 million and the Conservancy then sold it to the federal government for the same amount) agree on 1969 and the route through The Nature Conservancy. They disagree on the price; the exact day, October 20, rests on the FWS source.

sources.name: FWS, Savannah Coastal Refuges Complex CCP (2011), refuge purposes
